### Research

- **Disentangling the Cosmic Web** [2026]{.cvdate}
  - Focus: The Relationship Between Walls and Other Cosmic Structures
  - Built an automated pipeline (Python, Globus, DisPerSE, ParaView) to extract and quantify walls, filaments, and clusters from a 134-million-particle Quijote N-body simulation, tiled into 40 crops to fit in memory
  - Found that ~99% of filaments lie within walls and that walls hold ~51% of all particles at z = 0, establishing walls as structurally fundamental to the cosmic web
  - Regeneron International Science and Engineering Fair Finalist
  - Project website: [https://efuleky27.github.io/disperse/](https://efuleky27.github.io/disperse/)

- **Primordial Black Holes and Dark Matter** [2025]{.cvdate}
  - Focus: The Link Between the Early Universe and Modern Cosmology
  - Synthesized 10 published observational constraints to bound the fraction of dark matter attributable to primordial black holes, finding an upper limit of ~30.5% under the most restrictive constraint envelope
  - Hawaii State Science Fair Finalist
